units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:25">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 31:7">Prov. XXXI, 7</cite>) <he>על האובד יאמר שישכח המות שהיא רִישׁוֹ ועמלו</he> this refers to the lost (the culprit before execution), (give him to drink,) that he may forget the threatening death which is his misery and trouble.
